name: PC Power Meter Pro
description:
Track live power, measured energy, and estimated electricity cost from real iCUE power sensors on your XENEON Edge.

• See current watts, rolling history, session average, observed peak, Wh/kWh, today's measured energy, and estimated cost.
• Add extra iCUE power sensors as separate comparison traces instead of silently combining them.
• Keep local daily energy buckets and completed-session history.
• Set your electricity rate, graph window, comparison colors, and high-power threshold.

The primary measurement always follows the scope of the iCUE sensor you selected. CPU package power is not presented as whole-PC power, and missing or disconnected intervals are not filled with guessed energy.

Setup: choose the iCUE power sensor that matters to you, then set your electricity rate if you want cost estimates. No PackRat account or external service is required; history stays local to the widget instance.

Compatibility: Windows + CORSAIR XENEON Edge with an iCUE-exposed power sensor.

Made by PackRat.
release_notes: Initial Pro release. Primary measured power sensor plus separate comparison sensors, multi-line rolling graph, integrated session and daily energy, configurable electricity cost, local session history, 60 second through 10 minute graph windows, high power threshold, measured-scope labeling, strict disconnect/reconnect continuity, and tuned layouts for all eight XENEON size and orientation combinations.
